          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:103.81pt;top:78.92pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">September 16, 2016</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:199.73pt;top:78.92pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">19:41</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:103.81pt;top:135.71pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">T</span>
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07" style="font-style:italic;">he Hobbit</span>
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">  was first published in September 1937. Its 1951 second edition (fifth impression) contains a  </span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:103.81pt;top:148.90pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">significantly revised portion of Chapter V, “Riddles in the Dark,” which brings the story of </span>

            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07"> , then in progress. </span>

          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:93.88pt;top:70.56pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">September 16, 2016</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:175.95pt;top:70.56pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">19:45</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:93.88pt;top:95.02pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">In a hole in the ground there lived a hobbit. Not a nasty, dirty, wet hole, filled with the ends of worms and </span>

          <div class="stl_01" style="left:93.88pt;top:106.30pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">an oozy smell, nor yet a dry, bare, sandy hole with nothing in it to sit down on or to eat: it was a hobbit-</span>

            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">hole, and that means comfort.</span>

          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:102.62pt;top:77.91pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">September 16, 2016</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:196.86pt;top:77.91pt;">
            <span class="stl_08 stl_09 stl_07">19:46</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:102.62pt;top:122.90pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">They did not sing or tell stories that day, even though the weather improved; nor the next day, nor the day </span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:102.62pt;top:135.86pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">after. They had begun to feel that danger was not far away on either side. They camped under the stars, and</span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:102.62pt;top:148.82pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07"> their horses had more to eat than they had; for there was plenty of grass, but there was not much in their </span>
          </div>
          <div class="stl_01" style="left:102.62pt;top:161.78pt;">
            <span class="stl_10 stl_11 stl_07">bags, even with what they had got from the trolls.</span>
